audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-4].side all read 'Skill' but packet.levelChart and content.win[0-4] both say 'Rakan'; phases[5-6].side read 'Skill' but both say 'Taric'.
audit.why: Rakan's mobility, self-heal Q, and repeated engage-disengage keep tempo through level 5; Taric's double-cast Q and stun-punish only come online at first item. Content layer already reflects this.
audit.corrected: phases[0-4].side -> Rakan; phases[5-6].side -> Taric; ratings and whys rewritten to match.

audit.why: Level 6 (Cosmic Radiance nullifies The Quickness charm-engine), first item (double-cast Q out-sustains poke), and late (peel neutralizes flashy engage) are already correctly stated in spikes[].

The one missingInteraction (Gleaming Quill's sustain needs Grievous Wounds timing) is already covered in report[8].t itemization: 'Add anti-heal early into his duo's sustain.' No further action needed.

edits.before: Bravado-weave the trades — the empowered autos refund cooldowns; the loop is the lane.
edits.after: His mobility and self-heal Q control the opener — Bravado-weave what trades you take, but don't chase.

edits.before: Q-charges bank heals: the gemstone economy opens.
edits.after: Grand Entrance knockup outpaces your single-point heal — the gemstone economy isn't open yet.

edits.before: Full kit: W-link the carry and the E stuns from two bodies — the double angle is the trap.
edits.after: Battle Dance mobility keeps tempo with him at 3 — W-link the carry and hold E for the moment he commits the dash.

edits.before: Stun the margins off the link's geometry — their spacing answers two Tarics.
edits.after: His engage-disengage poke still beats your not-yet-scaled sustain — stun the margins off the link's geometry.

edits.before: Cosmic Radiance online — dives on your duo meet a scheduled invulnerability.
edits.after: The Quickness re-asserts his edge right before Cosmic Radiance value peaks — dives on your duo meet a scheduled invulnerability.

edits.before: First item: the stuns chain and the heals compound.
edits.after: First item: double-cast Q heal finally out-values his poke, and a landed stun punishes his mobility.

edits.before: Late Taric un-kills teamfights: R the dive, link the carry, and stun the formation twice per rotation.
edits.after: Late, R immunity and peel neutralize his flashy engage for good — his charm pick has nowhere to land.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Taric's E stuns Rakan out of Battle Dance recast range — land it before the second dash resets his shield.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: His passive shield recharges on a timer — trade right after he burns it and skip the free reduction.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Cosmic Radiance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Rakan Grand Entrance (11-7s by rank) starts every play — track him in fog; free-recast E extends it. The duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep R Cosmic Radiance (180/150/120s) banked for his The Quickness (130/110/90s), not a habit.
